_comment: Third-party code the extension bundles, pinned by version and SHA-256. scripts/build.mjs downloads each archive, refuses it if the hash differs, and copies only the files listed. Checked 2026-10-06: the npm tarballs match the registry's SHA-512 integrity; the PDF.js zip's build/pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs are byte-identical to pdfjs-dist 4.10.38 from npm; KaTeX and html2canvas files are byte-identical to the copies bundled before. To update one, see DESIGN.md "Updating PDF.js" (the same steps apply to KaTeX and html2canvas).
